title: Partner-aware Peptide-Protein Interaction Prediction and Target-conditioned Peptide Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.18467v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Motivation: Peptide-protein interactions (PepPIs) are central to cellular regulation and peptide therapeutics, but experimental characterization remains too slow for large-scale screening. Existing methods usually emphasize either interaction prediction or peptide generation, leaving candidate prioritization, residue-level interpretation, and target-conditioned expansion insufficiently integrated. Results: We present an integrated framework for early-stage peptide screening that combines a partner-aware prediction and localization model (ConGA-PepPI) with a target-conditioned generative model (TC-PepGen). ConGA-PepPI uses asymmetric encoding, bidirectional cross-attention, and progressive transfer from pair prediction to binding-site localization, while TC-PepGen preserves target information throughout autoregressive decoding via layerwise conditioning. In five-fold cross-validation, ConGA-PepPI achieved 0.839 accuracy and 0.92

translated_title: 基于伙伴感知的肽-蛋白质相互作用预测与靶标条件化肽生成
translated_abstract: 动机：肽-蛋白质相互作用（PepPIs）是细胞调控和肽类治疗的核心，但其实验表征对于大规模筛选而言仍然过于缓慢。现有方法通常只侧重于相互作用预测或肽生成，导致候选肽优先级排序、残基级解读和靶标条件化肽扩展未能充分整合。结果：我们提出了一个用于早期肽筛选的集成框架，该框架结合了伙伴感知的预测与定位模型以及靶标条件化生成模型。ConGA-PepPI采用非对称编码、双向交叉注意力以及从配对预测到结合位点定位的渐进式迁移学习，而TC-PepGen通过逐层条件化在自回归解码过程中持续保留靶标信息。在五折交叉验证中，ConGA-PepPI达到了0.839的准确率和0.92（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个集成框架，将伙伴感知的肽-蛋白质相互作用预测与结合位点定位模型ConGA-PepPI和靶标条件化肽生成模型TC-PepGen相结合，实现了相互作用预测、结合位点解读和靶标条件化肽生成的统一，用于加速早期肽类药物筛选。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an integrated framework combining ConGA-PepPI, a partner-aware model for peptide-protein interaction prediction and binding-site localization, with TC-PepGen, a target-conditioned peptide generation model, to unify candidate prioritization, residue-level interpretation, and target-conditioned peptide generation for early-stage peptide screening.
